record.original_question: Given positive semidefinite matrices A and B and positive real numbers p and q, is it always true for every unitarily invariant norm that |||A^(p+q)+B^(p+q)||| ≤ |||(A^p+B^p)(A^q+B^q)|||? The paper notes that one may reduce without loss of generality to 0≤p≤1 and q=1-p by absorbing the (p+q)-th powers into A and B.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ and $B$ be positive semidefinite matrices of the same finite size, and let $p,q>0$ be positive real numbers. A norm $|||\cdot|||$ on the space of complex matrices is called unitarily invariant if $|||UXV|||=|||X|||$ for all unitary matrices $U,V$ and all matrices $X$. 

Prove or disprove: for every unitarily invariant norm $|||\cdot|||$, every choice of positive semidefinite $A,B$, and every $p,q>0$,
$$|||A^{p+q}+B^{p+q}|||\;\le\;|||(A^{p}+B^{p})(A^{q}+B^{q})|||.$$

(One may, by absorbing $(p+q)$-th powers into $A$ and $B$, reduce without loss of generality to the case $0\le p\le 1$ and $q=1-p$.)
artifact.status_search_result: The inequality (Bourin's product-of-power-sums question) has been verified in several special cases — notably for the trace norm and the Hilbert–Schmidt norm by Hayajneh and Kittaneh, and subsequent partial results have appeared (extensions to certain symmetric norms, τ-measurable operators, and noncommutative symmetric spaces). However, the general case for all unitarily invariant norms and all p,q>0 is reported in the recent literature as still not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: A Unitarily Invariant Norm Inequality for Positive Semidefinite Matrices and a Question of Bourin
status_evidence.claim: The question remains an active area of research with partial answers.

status_evidence.title: Trace inequalities and a question of Bourin
status_evidence.snippet: Hayajneh–Kittaneh established the inequality for the trace norm and Hilbert–Schmidt norm.
status_evidence.claim: Confirmed for trace and Hilbert–Schmidt norms.

status_evidence.title: A norm inequality on noncommutative symmetric spaces related to a question of Bourin
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work extending partial results toward Bourin's conjecture in symmetric spaces; conjecture not fully settled in general.
status_evidence.claim: General case still open as of 2024.
